coordinates.note: CTAO's published array coordinate for CTAO-North (28°45′43.7904″N, 17°53′31.218″W), converted to decimal degrees. The MAGIC telescopes and the four LSTs stand within about 200 m of it (OpenStreetMap footprints on the local map), hence a 250 m precision for the shared telescope area.

name: Roque de los Muchachos gamma-ray telescope area
notes: No altitude is recorded: no source consulted states a specific altitude figure (public sources commonly cite roughly 2200-2400 m for the observatory, but that was not confirmed).

summary.plain: The mountaintop area on La Palma, Spain, where both the MAGIC telescopes and the northern half of the Cherenkov Telescope Array Observatory stand.
summary.technical: Shared approximate site for gamma-ray telescopes at the Roque de los Muchachos Observatory, La Palma, Canary Islands, Spain; hosts MAGIC and CTAO-North.
